import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); P=[(G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']) for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']]

from collections import Counter
def get_stamps(I,O,name):
    H,Wd=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in range(H-2):
        for c in range(Wd-2):
            blk=tuple(tuple(I[r+a][c+b] for b in range(3)) for a in range(3))
            if 2 in blk and 3 not in blk: cnt[blk]+=1

    # stamps in I (exact), stamps in O (with 8 ok)

    out=[(r,c) for r in range(H-2) for c in range(Wd-2) if all(O[r+a][c+b] in (M[a][b],8) for a in range(3) for b in range(3))]
    print(name,'motif',M,'inp anchors',inp,'out anchors',out)
